biotools.summary: ViNe-Seg is a deep-learning-assisted segmentation tool for visible neurons, offering a user-friendly graphical interface and seamless integration with subsequent analysis steps. It is available through PyPI and GitHub, enabling detection of neurons regardless of their activity status and facilitating expert supervision.
